tasks.description: Implement sibling value repair in build workflows. Add boundaryRepair() and unaccountedTestFiles() to build-implement.js; wire them into fix-loop sentinel and both boundary call sites. Add checkCriterionCoupling() as sixth graph-lint check to build-spec.js. Add optional needs_from_sibling field to ChangeSet in contracts.schema.json and update EvidenceBundle to record boundary_repairs. Update implementer.md documentation. All four surfaces modified atomically as one task to avoid bootstrap circularity (workflows execute committed source).
